statement: Pinned Dolphin Wii Remote emulation declares two 10-byte accelerometer calibration EEPROM blocks at offsets 0x0016 and 0x0020 following two 11-byte IR blocks. Only when no saved per-controller EEPROM image is loaded does its reset path synthesize accelerometer calibration fields (three zero-g axes, reserved byte, three one-g axes, two other bytes and one checksum). This describes emulator fallback layout, not factory defaults.

applicability.revision: Emulator or Linux/SDL host source behavior; retail revision not measured
applicability.scope: WiimoteEmu.h:257-268; WiimoteEmu.cpp:84,98-108 (saved-image selection),137-144 (fallback synthesis). No factory bytes or physical validation.
